bio.text: Oscar De Los Santos is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 11; the Arizona Legislature's member page lists the position of House Minority Leader.

According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, De Los Santos is a former sixth-grade English teacher who was head of public policy for Arizona food banks and earlier worked on President Obama's campaign and in the Obama White House.
The profile says De Los Santos is the son of Mexican immigrants, a Rhodes Scholar, and holds a Master of Public Policy from Oxford University.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 11 (candidate-submitted statements)
